_metadata.name: Bottleneck Operator Absence
_metadata.description: Simulates the unannounced absence of a grinder-certified operator at the start of Shift B, reducing bottleneck labor capacity by 50% for the day.

events.notes: Shift B grinder operator (Karthik) called in sick. GRINDER-01 is fully functional but lacks an operator. The engine must evaluate authorizing overtime for a Shift A operator or leaving the bottleneck idle.
